headline: China's Major State-Owned Banks Post Strongest Quarterly Profit Growth in Years
summary: Five of China's largest state-owned banks reported quarterly profit growth ranging between 6% and 11% as their margins stabilized.
why: China's major state-owned lenders form the backbone of the world's second-largest economy, and their earnings provide a key indicator of the health of the Chinese banking sector and broader economic stability.
why_moved: Stronger-than-expected profit growth and stabilizing margins signal improved financial health and resilience in China's state-backed banking sector.
